content:
Project Overview
ChronoSentiment MEGA FINAL — a financial sentiment analysis and trading system with a React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`), an observatory module, and multiple Python backend scripts for live sessions, replay certification, cohort management, symbol health, storage governance, and scheduling.

## Completed Work
1. Served the React app build via `python3 -m http.server 3001 --directory build` — returned HTTP 200.
2. Opened `http://localhost:3001` in browser and captured screenshot.
3. Confirmed the React app renders **ClientSync template** content ("Stop Client Chaos", "Run Your Agency Like a System") — wrong branding, indicating `App.js` was contaminated with a ClientSync template.
4. Confirmed CSS/static assets were broken (404s, Tailwind not loading) in the build.
5. Tested `observatory/suppression.html` in browser — marked complete (PASS).
6. Tested `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/deck.html` in browser — marked complete (PASS).
7. Tested `my-chrono-sentiment-ui` React app (build/index.html) — marked complete; contamination confirmed (FAIL).
8. Closed browser after confirming findings.
9. Reported findings — flagged ClientSync template contamination in `App.js`.
10. User said "check now" — `App.js` was recently modified; assistant re-read the file.
11. Confirmed `App.js` has been **restored to correct ChronoSentiment UI** — tabs for Run GA, Inspect Strategy, Compare Strategies, Global Ranking. ClientSync contamination is gone.
12. Initiated `npm run build` in `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/` — build completed successfully.
13. Build output: `72.83 kB build/static/js/main.f138c8da.js`, `104 B build/static/css/main.cf890fdb.css` — compiled successfully with no errors.
14. Killed old http.server on port 3001 and restarted with fresh build; confirmed HTTP 200 response.
15. Restyled all React components from Tailwind to `cs-*` design system: `App.js`, `RunGA.js`, `GlobalRanking.js`, `CompareStrategies.js`, `StrategyColumn.js`, `StrategyInspector.js`, `ComparisonPanels.js`, `NarrativeBlock.js`.
16. Updated `index.css` with full 811-line design system including `.cs-trace-block.dimmed`.
17. Rebuilt React app — new hashed bundles: `main.a7a67854.css` (3.17 kB gzip), `main.5022943e.js` (72.24 kB gzip).
18. **Committed all changes** — SHA `62dde2f0` on branch `post-qfth/cert-restore-and-gulf-validation`. 20 files changed, 1905 insertions, 1374 deletions. Commit message: "restyle: migrate React UI to ChronoSentiment cs-* design system".
19. User ran `--help` on `scripts/run_nse_cohort.py` — confirmed it accepts `--batch-id`, `--fresh`, `--shared-archive`, `--run-label`, `--resume`, `--rebuild-dedupe`, `--from-frozen`, `--start-interval`, `--max-intervals`. Script ingests alphabetical cohort batches via Rust cs-ingest.
20. User requested `--help` batch run on all core production scripts; command was issued but result not yet received (task interrupted).

## Key Technical Decisions
- Used `python3 -m http.server` instead of `serve -s build` to serve the React build.
- Screenshot captured to `/tmp/react_app_3001.png` for visual verification.
- After confirming `App.js` is restored, a full rebuild (`npm run build`) was required before re-serving and re-testing in browser.
- Migrated all component styling from Tailwind utility classes to custom `cs-*` CSS class design system defined in `index.css`.
- `StrategyInspector.js` uses `getGroupColorClass()` returning `cs-` modifiers.
- `ComparisonPanels.js` uses `verdictMod` passing `confidenceColorClass` directly.
- `NarrativeBlock.js` uses `cs-trace-block` with `active`/`divergent`/`dimmed` states.

## Relevant Files & Code

## Current Status
Task resumed after 1-hour interruption. The batch `--help` command for all core production scripts was issued but the result was not received. The terminal shows the command is still actively running. Need to retrieve the output of that command to assess script health.

## Pending Tasks
